I couldn't jump playback to the finale from here: this session has no tool for sending a performance signal, and I made no edits.

`finale` does exist as a part in the song (it is round 0 of the six-round finale block). The jump it needs is `sendSignal('go', 'finale')`.

Two ways to get there yourself:
- **Performance mode on** (the checkbox next to play): type just `finale` in this panel and it is dispatched directly without going through me. Or run `sendSignal('go', 'finale')` in the browser console. It jumps on the next bar line.
- **Performance mode off:** the waits are inert and the song simply plays through to the finale. To audition from there, put your own `playFromHere()` just above the `for (let round = 0; ...` loop (around line 868). I won't add that marker for you, since it is your audition marker.

If you meant something else, such as working on the finale section, tell me what to change.

I still can't send the jump from this session, because it has no tool for performance signals. I made no edits. `break` does exist as a part, at line 290, between `chorus3` and `drop`.

- **Performance mode on:** type just `break` in this panel and it is dispatched directly without me. Or run `sendSignal('go', 'break')` in the browser console. It jumps on the next bar line.
- **Performance mode off:** put your own `playFromHere()` just above `part('break');` to audition from there.

The part names you can jump to are `before`, `intro`, `verse`, `chorus`, `chorus2`, `chorus3`, `break`, `drop`, `breakdown`, `finale`, `finale-stabs`, `finale-italo`, `finale-italo2`, `solo` and `ending`.

`verse` reached me instead of being dispatched as a jump. Going by the docs, that suggests performance mode is off, though I can't check the checkbox from here. With it on, a bare part name typed in this panel is dispatched directly and never reaches the model. I still can't send the signal myself, and I made no edits.

- Tick the **performance mode** checkbox next to the play control, start playback, then type `verse` here again. Running `sendSignal('go', 'verse')` in the browser console does the same. It jumps on the next bar line.
- With performance mode off, the waits are inert and the song plays straight through. To hear it from the verse, put your own `playFromHere()` just above the `for` loop containing `part(['verse', 'chorus', ...][rep])` (around line 185).

If performance mode is already on and `verse` still came through to me, the direct dispatch isn't firing. That would be a bug in the app, not something in the song.
